On a different note...I queued up Progeny on Advanced (of course), and I finally beat him for the first time.

I randomed Chrono, Scholar, Dark Watch Fixer, Captain Cosmic, and Argent.  From the ~ENCLAVE OF THE ENDLINGS!~

The key are he didn't get out his destruction cards or Scion of Frost to heal until 2/3 down in HP.  I had calculated Chrono would be a good matchup as he deals multiple instances of damage easily in a turn, and he proved me right.  Bow FTW.

I hadn't been close at all in beating him on Advanced.  60 during previous attempts.  I did think I would do it on Steam first just for fast book keeping and restarts.  Overall, he didn't play his best stuff, and I just kept attacking.  I didn't really have many cards out since DW Fixer and he has double Scion of Toxicity eating those.

Scholar was at 2, Fixer was at 1, and I would have lost next turn for sure.
